usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover the top-level PBS (Proxmox Backup Server) remotes resource index on a PDM instance. It is a directory listing only and requires no parameters; any authenticated user or API token can call it. The actual list of configured PBS remotes is retrieved via child endpoints under /pbs.

examples.summary: Retrieve the PBS remotes directory index

tips: This endpoint returns null per the spec — it functions as a navigational index entry point, not a data payload; follow up with /pbs child endpoints to get actionable PBS remote data.
No privilege elevation is needed; a read-only API token scoped to any realm is sufficient.
